name: Wren Calloway
what: Apprentice archivist, seventeen, the player character. Breaks the Archive's first rule on her first day.
maps_to: player character, curiosity as a mechanic (tasting salt unlocks dialogue)
visual: Thin girl, cropped black hair, oversized grey archivist coat, salt-stained gloves, satchel

name: The Brinewarden
what: Keeper of the Salt Archive. Seals memories to spare the living their grief (DECISIONS 3).
maps_to: boss fight that can end in talk, gatekeeper of locked areas
visual: Tall old woman, white robes crusted with salt, iron key ring, calm face

name: Old Tamsin
what: Smuggler and market trader who sells memories the Archive never sealed. Knew Wren's mother (proposed).
maps_to: merchant, quest giver for trade quests
visual: Stout woman in a patched oilskin, gold teeth, many rings, pipe

name: Saltborn
what: Gulls that ate memory salt and now repeat the words of the dead (proposed).
maps_to: ambient creature, hint system, bestiary entry
visual: White gulls with crystal-grey eyes and salt crust on the wings (proposed)

name: The Salt Archive
what: A drowned cathedral where memory salt is shelved in sealed jars. Its lower stacks are underwater at high tide.
maps_to: hub area, stealth section in the sealed stacks
visual: Half-flooded cathedral nave, endless shelves of glowing salt jars, green water
lighting: cold blue daylight from high windows, faint white glow from the jars

name: Low Tide Market
what: A market on the rooftops that only opens when the tide is out.
maps_to: shop, timed area that closes at high tide
visual: Stalls on slate rooftops, rope bridges, lanterns, wet stone
lighting: orange lanterns against a grey dusk

name: The Undertow
what: Smugglers who believe every memory belongs to whoever is left alive.
maps_to: rival faction, stealth and trade quests, raid event
visual: Figures in black oilskins with blue scarves over the face, small boats

name: The Great Drowning
what: The night the sea took the lower city, forty years ago. Most of the Archive's salt comes from it.
visual: A city street at night with the sea pouring over the rooftops

name: Memory lamp
what: A brass lamp that burns memory salt and throws the memory on a wall, so no one has to taste it.
maps_to: key item, puzzle tool, replaces a dialogue choice with a cutscene
visual: Small brass oil lamp with a glass chimney full of white salt

name: Brine knife
what: A short knife the Undertow uses to pry the Archive's seals.
visual: Short curved blade, rope-wrapped handle, salt crust on the edge

name: Tidecaller skiff
what: A flat boat the smugglers pole through the drowned streets.
visual: Narrow flat black boat, long pole, a lantern hung at the bow

name: White salt
what: A memory crystallized when someone died near the sea. Tasting it replays the memory (DECISIONS 2).
maps_to: currency, healing item, collectible lore pages
visual: Coarse white crystals with a faint inner glow, in small corked jars

name: Wren Tastes a Sealed Memory
what: Alone in the stacks, Wren opens a sealed jar and tastes it. She sees a stranger drowning and knows his name.
maps_to: tutorial for the tasting mechanic, a curse that is also a gift
visual: A girl in a flooded aisle, a cracked jar, white light on her face

name: The Brinewarden Seals the Stack
what: The Brinewarden finds the open jar and seals the whole aisle, without punishing Wren.
maps_to: locked area, a boss who chooses mercy
visual: An old woman turning an iron key in a shelf gate, salt dust falling

name: Tamsin Trades the Lamp
what: Tamsin sells Wren the memory lamp for one jar of salt she has not tasted.
maps_to: trade quest, a deal with a hidden price
visual: A rooftop stall at dusk, a brass lamp handed across, gold teeth grinning

name: The Lamp Shows the Drowning
what: The lamp throws the Great Drowning on the market wall. Everyone at the stalls stops to watch.
maps_to: backstory cutscene, an area-wide effect that stops every enemy
visual: A whole rooftop crowd lit by a projected wave on a wall

name: The Undertow Raids the Archive
what: At high tide the smugglers pole skiffs into the nave and pry open the sealed stacks.
maps_to: raid event, stealth level, timed escape
visual: Black boats inside a flooded cathedral, knives at glowing jars
